description: This file defines a VideoRecorder class responsible for capturing video frames, encoding them using ffmpeg, and saving the output as a WebM video. It includes methods for launching ffmpeg, writing frames, and stopping the recording process.

classes.name: VideoRecorder
classes.description: A class for recording video frames, encoding them with ffmpeg, and saving as a WebM file.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the VideoRecorder with ffmpeg path and options, and starts the launch process.

methods.name: _launch
methods.description: Asynchronously launches ffmpeg process with specified parameters for video encoding.

methods.name: writeFrame
methods.description: Queues a video frame for encoding and writing to the output file.

methods.name: _writeFrame
methods.description: Handles the logic of queuing frames, repeating last frames if needed, and updating timestamps.

methods.name: _sendFrames
methods.description: Sends all queued frames to ffmpeg process.

methods.name: _sendFrame
methods.description: Writes a single frame buffer to ffmpeg stdin.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the recording, finalizes the video, and closes ffmpeg process.
